content.short: 3six9 is an NFT marketplace co-founded by Beh Kim Chin and Beryn Teoh that lets users buy, sell, and trade NFTs using MetaMask and Rainbow Bridge.
content.description: 3six9 is an NFT marketplace co-founded by Beh Kim Chin and Beryn Teoh. Users can buy and sell NFTs on the platform by connecting their MetaMask wallet, and purchases can also be completed via Rainbow Bridge. The long-term vision is to offer an easy-to-use, all-in-one NFT platform with features such as fractional NFTs, peer-to-peer microloans, auctions, and launchpads, delivering a cohesive set of tools for creators and collectors.
content.meta: 3six9 is an NFT marketplace where users can discover, buy, and trade digital collectibles. Discover 3six9 and other NFT Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
